texts.Programs_Cohort_DragHint: You can also drag a person, or everyone ticked, onto the member list above.
texts.Programs_Cohort_MembersEmpty: Nobody is in this cohort yet.
texts.Programs_Dashboard_Intro: How your programs are doing in the period you pick. Figures count only the records you can see.
texts.Programs_Elig_Intro: Rules are checked in order, and the first whose conditions all hold decides. Screening sets each open enrollment's Eligibility Status, Basis and Reason.
texts.Programs_Fail_Cohort: The cohort was not loaded or changed. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_Dashboard: The dashboard did not load. Try again, or pick a shorter period. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_Elig: The eligibility rules were not loaded or saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_Log: The service delivery log was not loaded or saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_PersonCard: The Programs card did not load. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_Plan: The service plan was not loaded or saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_RecordService: The service was not recorded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_Roster: The roster was not loaded or updated. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_Schedule: No sessions were scheduled. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_SettingsLoad: The Programs settings were not loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Fail_SettingsSave: Participant Privacy was not saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Programs_Home_CaseNoteTile: Private notes on a person's enrollment.
texts.Programs_Home_CohortTile: Groups that go through a program together.
texts.Programs_Home_CountTile: Head counts of people served without an enrollment.
texts.Programs_Home_DeliveryTile: Each service a person received, day by day.
texts.Programs_Home_EnrollmentTile: Who is in which program, and at what stage.
texts.Programs_Home_GoalTile: The goals in each person's service plan.
texts.Programs_Home_ProgramTile: Your programs, their services and who runs them.
texts.Programs_Home_ReferralTile: Referrals to and from other organizations.
texts.Programs_Home_SessionTile: Scheduled meetings of a service, with attendance.
texts.Programs_Log_Empty: Nobody has an open enrollment in this program yet.
texts.Programs_Plan_Empty: No goals yet. Add the first goal this person is working toward.
texts.Programs_Plan_ReviewIntro: Reviewed today. When is the next review? Leave it blank for none.
texts.Programs_RecordService_NoAccess: You can see services but not record them. Ask your BarnCRM admin if you need to.
texts.Programs_RecordService_NoServices: There is no active service to record. Add one in a program's Services list first.
texts.Programs_Roster_Empty: No one to list. Click Enroll Someone to add a person, or turn on Show Ended to see past enrollments.
texts.Programs_Schedule_EndBeforeStart: Choose an end time after the start time, or leave the end time empty.
texts.Programs_Schedule_IntroProgram: Sessions scheduled here are for everyone enrolled in the program. To schedule for one cohort, use the panel on the cohort.
texts.Programs_Schedule_SavedRepeating: Repeating schedule saved. Sessions created: {0}. BarnCRM keeps adding them each night; manage it under Session Schedules.
texts.Programs_SessionSchedule_EditNote: Sessions exist through {0}. A change to the days or times applies after that day; to apply it to sessions already created, use Remove Future Sessions.
texts.Programs_SessionSchedule_Inactive: This schedule is not active, so it creates no new sessions. The sessions it made stay. Tick Active to start it again.
texts.Programs_SessionSchedule_RemoveConfirm: Remove this schedule's sessions after today that are still Scheduled and have no attendance? Held, cancelled and attended sessions stay. An active schedule then creates the removed days again from its current days and times.
texts.Programs_SessionSchedule_TurnedOff: Programs is turned off in Module Manager, so no sessions are created.
texts.Programs_SessionSchedule_UpToDate: Every session is created through {0}. BarnCRM adds more each night.
texts.Programs_Settings_Intro: The choices your organization makes for the Programs module. Changes apply to everyone.
texts.Programs_Settings_PicklistsIntro: The choices staff pick from on an enrollment. Add, rename or deactivate a choice on the field in Setup; a deactivated choice stays on the enrollments that have it.
texts.Programs_Settings_PrivacyIntro: Who can see enrollments and service deliveries. Every case note stays private whichever you choose.
